xml-formatter.privacyNote: This tool runs 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
xml-formatter.name: XML Formatter
xml-formatter.tagline: Pretty-print and validate XML with clean indentation.
xml-formatter.metaTitle: XML Formatter - Pretty Print & Validate XML Free Online
xml-formatter.metaDescription: Format XML with clean indentation and validate it instantly. Adjustable indent, error messages, copy or download. Free, no signup, in your browser.
xml-formatter.keywords: xml formatter, pretty print xml, xml validator, format xml online, beautify xml
xml-formatter.quickAnswer: Paste XML and this tool validates it with the browser XML parser, then reprints it with clean, consistent indentation you control. Malformed XML shows the exact parser error so you can fix it. Copy the formatted result or download it as a file.
keyFacts: XML requires strict well-formedness: every tag must close and nest correctly.
The browser built-in XML parser validates structure before formatting begins.
Indentation is cosmetic; it never changes the data or meaning of the XML.
Comments and CDATA sections are preserved in the formatted output.
An XML declaration (<?xml ...?>) is kept at the top when present.
howTo: Paste your XML into the editor.
Set the indent size (1 to 8 spaces).
Read any validation error and fix the XML if needed.
Copy the formatted XML or download it as formatted.xml.
Use the sample button to see formatting in action.
xml-formatter.formula: Input: xy Output: x y Rule: each nested level adds one indent unit; text-only elements stay on one line.
xml-formatter.workedExample:
Input:
<catalog><book id="bk101"><title>XML Guide</title><price>29.99</price></book></catalog>
Output with 2-space indent:
<catalog>
  <book id="bk101">
    <title>XML Guide</title>
    <price>29.99</price>
  </book>
</catalog>
Attributes stay on the opening tag; text-only elements stay on one line.
benefits: Readable XML is far easier to debug and review.
Adjustable indent matches your team style.
Everything runs locally; sensitive XML stays private.
limitations: Validates well-formedness only, not against an XSD or DTD schema.
External entities and DTDs are not resolved.
Very large documents (over ~50KB of text) may format slowly.
Namespace prefixes are preserved but not validated.

faqs.a: The XML breaks basic rules: an unclosed tag, mismatched nesting, or a stray character. The error message names the line and column to fix.
No. Only whitespace between elements changes. Text content, attributes, comments, and CDATA are preserved exactly.

faqs.q: Can it validate against my XSD?
faqs.a: No. This tool checks well-formedness (correct syntax), not schema validity. For XSD validation you need a dedicated validator.
Yes. XML comments and CDATA sections are preserved in the formatted output.
No. Parsing and formatting run entirely in your browser.
